title: Implement bounded native structural observations
review_scope: implementation_commit 1050c33 (native/inkflip/checks/structure.py + native/tests/structure/test_structure.py) plus the evidence commit on this branch

deliverables.native/inkflip/checks/structure.py: bounded structural observation check over PDFium: per-text-object render mode (raw Tr integer + PDF-semantics interpreted name), fill/stroke color, font base name, bounded text snippet, axis-aligned object boxes mapped to canonical page space; inspectable page properties (effective view, UserUnit, rotation, physical size) via the pypdf dictionary adapter path; off-crop text objects keep raw unclipped geometry; approximate top-level opaque-rectangle overlap experiment; finite object/form/text budgets; typed terminals and per-occurrence limitations
deliverables.native/tests/structure/test_structure.py: TEST-28 suite: 17 tests + 14 subtests over committed fixtures (F03 scan, F02 covered overlap control, F07 user-unit) and hand-assembled minimal PDFs for Tr sweep 0..7, F04-style white-contrast controls, off-crop geometry, ExtGState alpha and nested Form XObjects

executable_example: uv run --project native python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'native'); from inkflip.readers import pdfium; from inkflip.checks import structure; h=pdfium.open_document(open('fixtures/development/scan-correct.pdf','rb').read(),None,1); out=[]; r=structure.extract(h,{'id':'demo','page_index':0,'reader_ids':[structure.READER_ID],'capability':'object_render_mode','region_id':None},out.extend); print(r['status'], r['produced_occurrence_count']); h.close()"

executed_commands.command: uv run --project native python -m pytest native/tests/structure -q
uv run --project native python -m pytest native/tests -q

executed_commands.note: run.json binds evaluated_commit 1050c33 on a clean tree

measured_decisions.decision: Render-mode raw Tr passthrough recorded with PDF-semantics names
measured_decisions.reason: Empirically verified on PDFium 149.0.7825.0: `3 Tr` (invisible) reads back as raw 3 while pypdfium2 names 3 FILL_STROKE; mapping through the enum would misreport invisible text. Both raw and name travel on every observation; the Tr sweep test pins it.

measured_decisions.decision: No hidden/visible verdict exists in this check
measured_decisions.reason: CAPABILITIES.md gives native overlap the approximate opaque-rectangle experiment with no automatic hidden/safe label; tests assert the F03/F04 controls (invisible layer, white-on-dark vs white-on-light) produce no verdict-bearing output.

measured_decisions.decision: Top-level traversal only; nested forms recorded, not entered
measured_decisions.reason: READER_ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md requires a finite nesting/object budget; form contents and alpha compositing are recorded as unsupported instead of a claimed comprehensive inspection.

review_attention: The render-mode interpretation table is PDF content-stream semantics, deliberately NOT the pypdfium2 enum names; raw integer always accompanies it.

F04/F05/F06 fixture families are catalog 'specified' on this base: criteria covered with committed fixtures plus hand-assembled in-memory minimal PDFs; committed families remain a fixture-lane request.

Occurrence.raw_text carries the object's extracted text for object_render_mode observations only; page-property, overlap, off-crop and form records are structural observations with structured locators and basis strings.
limitations: Printed structural properties only; no blending, OCG, transparency-group or historical-revision inspection.
Object boxes are PDFium-reported axis-aligned user-space bounds mapped once by the canonical transform; API geometry, not exact visible ink.
No OCR, rendering or model use in this task.
dependency_requests: Fixture owner lane: committed F04/F05/F06 families per catalog recipes when assigned.
attribution: No external material reused; contract-cited source ideas are credited in planning/research/SOURCES.md.
